header.desc: Help us make the building and infrastructure sector open source. We currently have one open position.

job.title: Experienced System Administrator / DevOps (open source)

about.title: About us
about.desc: The OpenAEC Foundation is making the building and infrastructure sector open source. We develop, support and promote a complete ecosystem of open-source software for the entire AEC chain — already 17 production tools, 50+ repositories and thousands of downloads. Modelled on the Blender Foundation: everything open, everything free, forever. Behind those tools runs a growing, fully self-hosted infrastructure — and it needs an experienced administrator to take ownership of it.

do.title: What you will do
do.1: Set up and manage servers — Linux servers (Debian/Ubuntu) from bare metal to production, including reverse proxy, TLS, DNS and containerisation (Docker)
do.2: NextCloud — set up, scale and maintain it as a document platform (incl. OpenAEC Docs and IfcGit integration)
do.3: Stalwart Mail Server — manage our self-hosted email stack (IMAP/JMAP/SMTP) that powers the Y-app: deliverability, DKIM/SPF/DMARC, anti-spam
do.4: Safety & security — hardening, firewalls, fail2ban, secrets management, patching, GDPR, audit logging and a backup & disaster-recovery policy that actually works
do.5: Monitoring & uptime — proactive monitoring so problems surface before the customer notices them
do.6: Managed hosting — you support our paid hosting/SLA services for construction firms that want a managed environment

who.title: Who we are looking for
who.1: Experienced — you have demonstrably run Linux servers in production and know what breaks at 3 a.m.
who.2: Independent — you like working autonomously, take initiative and make the call yourself
who.3: Security mindset — you think in threat models, least privilege and backups-that-work by default
who.4: Open source in your blood — you feel at home in a Linux/CLI/Git world
who.5: Bonus: experience with Hetzner, Cloudflare, Proxmox, Ansible/Terraform, PostgreSQL/Redis, Prometheus/Grafana or self-hosted mail

offer.title: What we offer
offer.1: A key role in a mission-driven open-source foundation in the making
offer.2: Full freedom and ownership over the infrastructure — no locked-down processes
offer.3: Work with a modern, 100% open-source stack (Linux, Rust, Tauri, NextCloud, Stalwart)
offer.4: Hybrid working — workplace in Dordrecht, and working from home is perfectly fine

apply.title: Interested?
apply.desc: Send a short email with your experience — a CV or GitHub profile tells us more than a cover letter.
